Professional Summary
Tech transformation leader with 7 years of experience improving semiconductor yield,
accelerating conversion timelines, and scaling AI-integrated process innovation across fabs
in the U.S., Japan, Taiwan, and Singapore. Led Micron’s LPDDR5X and HBM3E yield ramps—
powering the iPhone 16 Pro Max and NVIDIA’s H200 GPU—by resolving complex
manufacturing bottlenecks and enabling faster time-to-market for advanced products.
Architected a 5-year roadmap for autonomous conversions and developed systems that
enable process engineers to update the bill of materials (BoM) during conversions—
enhancing visibility into material usage, greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, and sustainability
metrics. Singaporean with 2 years of cumulative international work travel aligning cross-site
teams, suppliers, and global strategy.
